question: Can a social security agreement help me qualify for a Canadian pension if I spent part of my working life abroad?
generated_answer:
The answer depends on the country where you worked. You may be able to count your time in that country toward the Canadian pension you are applying for. This is possible if Canada has a social security agreement with the other country. To find out if you can count your time in another country toward your Canadian pension, contact us.
